text:
mai: Heads-up: support reported tenants seeing quota spikes billed to org-default even though calls include x-impersonated-project.
oscar: can you attach a minimal trace? which headers made it to the ingest service?
mai: trace snippet: ```authorization: Bearer sa-imp-token
x-impersonated-project: p-77
x-origin-sa: sa-exporter-9```
pat: we treat `x-impersonated-project` as untrusted unless the proxy validated it. quota-ingest currently prefers proxy's x-resolved-project header when present.
quinn: looks like a race - ingress reads headers before the proxy writes resolved header. we should prefer a signed header from proxy so ingest can trust it.
oscar: short-term UX: show both fields on quota dashboard (Raw header vs Resolved) behind a flag so customers see what was claimed vs what was attributed. low-risk.
pat: long-term: proxy emits `x-resolved-project: p-77;sig=...;ts=...` and ingest verifies sig. prevents client spoofing and ordering bugs.
mai: rollout plan suggestion: 1) dashboard flag to surface both fields, 2) instrument telemetry `auth.impersonation.resolved` at 5% sample, 3) implement signed header verification behind flag, 4) canary signed-header on subset tenants, 5) flip after 48h clean.
quinn: add alert: if resolved != raw_header for >0.5% of traffic per tenant over 1h, page oncall.
oscar: owners - mai -> dashboard + support note, pat -> ingest change + verifier, quinn -> proxy signing + canary, oscar -> dashboards/alerts.
ci-bot: scheduled canary: proxy/signed-resolved-header -> canary-3 (4 hosts) at 2026-03-26T04:00:00Z :rocket:
mai: docs+support playbook update please include steps to compare raw vs resolved and request attribution re-eval.
pat: will add smoke tests for known impersonation flows and assert ingest picks signed header over raw.
oscar: thanks team, small iterative changes should reduce customer confusion quickly. :thumbsup:
